mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scm_supplier WHERE bool_delete_enum = false AND date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') = date_format(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT ss.id as supplier_id, ss.name as supplier_name, ss.supplier_classification FROM scm_supplier AS ss WHERE ss.bool_delete_enum = 0
and ss.name like concat('%',#{supplierName},'%')
and ss.supplier_classification & #{supplierClassification} > 0

SELECT * FROM scm_supplier WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0
and supplier_classification & #{basicClass} > 0
order by create_time desc
